a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 cells needs two clean generator rounds, so it gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every remaining round and give back anything I can spare, to rebuild the reserve for you. If you'd rather settle this another way, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves the reserve empty for you. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
